A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same CaMVo research work. Their main text, equations, tables, figures, and complete appendices are readable, allowing retained, added, and removed material to be matched reliably.

before.justification: v1 reports original accuracy, cost, learning-trajectory, and input-ordering experiments on MMLU and IMDB in Section 4 and Appendices D–E.

after.justification: v2 retains those empirical results and adds AG News evaluation, CCaMVo comparisons, and synthetic correlation experiments in Appendices F–H.

M1.justification: v2 adds CCaMVo, an optional extension replacing independent-output subset-confidence estimation with online pairwise correlation estimation, Gaussian-copula sampling, and Monte Carlo voting-confidence estimation (Appendix G, Algorithms 3–4). This substantially extends the procedure while retaining the original CaMVo framework.

E1.justification: Beyond the retained MMLU and IMDB tasks, v2 evaluates four-category news classification on AG News and synthetic context-dependent LLM outputs with controlled correlation structures (Appendices F and H). These add a domain and distinct dependence scenarios.

E2.justification: The original individual-LLM, full-ensemble Majority Vote, and online Baseline Method comparisons remain. CCaMVo is added as a head-to-head comparator to CaMVo, including on the existing MMLU and IMDB benchmarks (Tables 10–13), providing a limited comparator expansion.

E3.justification: v2 adds per-label precision, recall, and F1 evaluation; an AG News protocol sampling 50,000 training-set instances with temperature 0.3; and synthetic experiments varying pairwise and contextual correlations with d = 5 and noise scale 0.5. The stated settings of the original MMLU and IMDB experiments remain unchanged.

E4.justification: v2 adds category-level diagnostics, tests the benefit of explicitly modeling correlations, and evaluates sensitivity to homogeneous and heterogeneous correlation structures (Appendices D–H). It also adds AG News ordering tests while removing the earlier kmin = 3 learning-trajectory and ordering analyses for MMLU and IMDB.

E5.justification: Both versions report means and one-standard-deviation bands over 20 random shuffles. However, v2 removes the kmin = 3 uncertainty panels previously included in Figures 5 and 10, retaining only kmin = 1 panels. AG News adopts the existing reporting practice rather than introducing a new uncertainty procedure.

E6.justification: Original Tables 2–4 retain their numerical results, but v2 adds class metrics, AG News results, CCaMVo comparisons, and synthetic findings in Tables 5–19. For example, AG News CaMVo at delta = 0.99 and kmin = 1 achieves 86.18% accuracy at cost 2.98, versus the online baseline's 85.68% at 6.79 dollars per million input tokens (Tables 8–9).

T1.justification: Lemma 2.1 and Proposition B.1 retain their conclusions. Appendix A makes the worst-case argument explicit by setting correctness probabilities equal to their lower bounds, while Appendices G–H add formal copula and context-dependent correctness-model definitions. No new performance guarantee is proved.

C1.justification: The abstract and introduction's principal contributions remain unchanged. v2 additionally presents CCaMVo as a practical relaxation of independence and claims in the conclusion that regression and ranking extensions require only minor modifications, modestly broadening the stated applicability.

C2.justification: v2 substantially expands interpretation beyond v1's independence warning. It attributes limited CCaMVo gains to contextual confidence estimates already capturing dependencies and to correlation-estimation error, discusses AG News category ambiguity, and acknowledges that the synthetic generator does not exactly reproduce target accuracies and correlations.

D1.justification: v2 supplies AG News prompts and title-description preprocessing, implementation-level correlation and sampling pseudocode, and synthetic-generation parameters and correlation matrices. It also newly documents probability clipping and makes query-count bookkeeping explicit in Algorithm 1; these disclosures do not establish that the retained experiments were rerun.

R1.justification: v2 adds Bahadur (1961) to motivate dependent binary-output modeling and Zhang, Zhao, and LeCun (2015) for AG News. The related-work discussion, comparison table, and central novelty positioning otherwise remain essentially unchanged.

P1.justification: Most existing prose and section organization are retained. Local edits clarify predicted-label agreement and regularization, standardize notation, expand the conclusion, and update acknowledgments; Section 4.3 introduces the new appendices. This is not a broad rewrite of the existing narrative.

P2.justification: v2 adds Tables 5–19, Algorithms 3–5, and AG News Figures 9–12, substantially expanding the visual presentation. Earlier kmin = 3 figure groups and uncertainty panels are removed, retained plots are redistributed, and Figures 1–2 add cyan markers displaying already-reported individual-LLM results.

improvement.justification: AG News evaluation and direct correlation investigations broaden validation and address a central limitation that v1 mainly discussed. The benefit is tempered by reporting problems: Table 5 duplicates metrics across kmin settings despite conflicting accuracies in Table 3, and CCaMVo's IMDB target misses in Tables 12–13 receive no substantive discussion. These issues limit confidence in the additions, leaving a modest net improvement.
